logit_chunk_f32.note: two chunk tensors (student, teacher); log-softmax and p_t add at most two more of the same size inside a chunk

memory_table_bf16.note: 4 insertion layers x 2^18 rows x 256 values, resident and included in the student's accessible count; listed separately because it is the largest single added tensor

components_note: weights and chunked logits only; the runtime's CUDA context, cuBLAS workspaces and load transients are named by the measured peak, not by this sum

device.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER
device.usable_basis: device total less the desktop compositor's resident allocation; the binding constraint on this host

host_limits.note: host RAM limit for the court container; VRAM is not a cgroup resource and is bounded by the arithmetic above

kill_condition: abort if torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated at any stage exceeds 12.5 GiB; the instrument logs it per stage
